ideas.pitch: A real-time audio surveillance integration tool that processes crowd noise and acoustic triggers using lightweight ML, instantly streaming geolocation and threat classification to a local police dashboard.
ideas.title: Indore-Pulse Geo-Audio Gunshot and Distress Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the collaboration priority of Indore Police for digital safety and law enforcement tech, matching the proven architecture of previous real-time audio mapping winners.

ideas.pitch: An edge-optimized video processing pipeline that ingests simulated CCTV feeds, runs fast facial recognition against a localized database of wanted individuals, and dispatches automated alert emails with timestamped snapshots to law enforcement officers.
ideas.title: CCTV Wanted-Criminal Face Match and Alert Net
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses direct public safety workflows established by police departments, copying a proven hackathon runner-up architecture scoped down for a fast MVP.

ideas.pitch: A crowd-sourced safety assistant that aggregates anonymous distress reports and municipal lighting data to dynamically calculate and suggest the safest transit routes through urban areas.
ideas.title: SafeRoute AI: Localized Digital Harassment and Darkspot Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of safety assistants that solve hyper-local municipal and citizen protection problems with a polished, working mobile UI.

ideas.pitch: A public accountability web application where civic complaints and police station filings are sealed with cryptographic proofs, ensuring that local authorities cannot tamper with or delete public safety logs.
ideas.title: ProofSeal: Cryptographically Verified Municipal Grievance Portal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to judges looking for transparency and tamper-proof auditing in public-facing safety infrastructure, matching recent civic-tech hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An automated multi-agent pipeline that crawls regional social media channels and messaging platforms to detect phishing campaigns and digital scams targeting students and citizens, providing automated risk scoring.
ideas.title: PhishTrace: Multi-Agent Cyber Threat Intelligence Scraper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced multi-agent scraping workflows with practical cyber-defense mechanisms requested by law enforcement partners.
